Die Übernahme wird direkt bei Cembra bea: The takeover is applied for directly with Cembra; once the credit check has been passed, the company transfers the contract to the new person. Leased vehicles carry code 178 in the vehicle registration document (ALB clause 16.9) – without AMAG's approval, nothing happens at the road traffic office.
